root_cause_verification.rationale: Root cause was 'check_cross_agent() function lacks POI time conflict detection'. Implementation directly addresses this by adding 114 lines (943-1057) of POI collection and time conflict detection logic to check_cross_agent(). Function now: (1) Collects POIs from attractions, entertainment, shopping, meals per day, (2) Compares all POI pairs across different agents, (3) Detects identical times (HIGH if both non-optional), (4) Detects overlapping times (MEDIUM severity). Jinli duplicate (symptom) successfully detected, proving root cause fixed.

regression_test_results.details: Implementation only adds new POI time conflict detection (lines 943-1057) to check_cross_agent(). No modifications to existing validation categories 1-5 or other check_cross_agent logic (day count, date consistency, location consistency, budget consistency). All existing checks still execute.

Implementation handles missing/invalid fields gracefully: (1) Skips POIs where 'time' field missing or not dict (line 1014), (2) Skips if time.start/end missing (lines 1016-1019), (3) Skips if time values empty (line 1025), (4) Uses .get('optional', False) for missing optional field (lines 959, 974, 989, 1003). No schema changes required.

Only scripts/plan-validate.py modified (lines 872-1058 extended). No changes to: save.py, agent JSON files, schemas, other validation scripts. Implementation scope matches requirement specification exactly.
